label: Protective process safety and omission controls
description: Checked formal model controls only. The flame baseline has an actual two-edge terminal destruction of bearer true; guarded history shares its initial state and interrupts the first flame edge. Bypass and later replacement remain possible admitted histories, so blocking one process is not unqualified protection. Independent CausesIn may remain empty despite realized protection. No statement about original direct conservation, real fire, or all possible histories.

research_comparisons.scope: One fixed Model Bool Bool Stage; the identical bearer true and shared initial ready state; only sampled times 0,1,2.
research_comparisons.coverage: Two supplied process identities and four states; baseline flame, guarded, direct bypass and later replacement traces. No global adequacy of this roster is claimed.
research_comparisons.exclusivity: The action is the supplied guarding episode; different process identities may threaten the same bearer. No metaphysical exclusivity premise.
